item.name: Charge the saved card to top up prepaid balance

request.description: Charges the org's default saved card off-session. The balance credit is applied by the payment_intent.succeeded webhook (the authoritative money signal), not this response — poll the balance after success.

response.name: Charge outcome (status drives the dashboard's next step)
